build_kalign_aligner: build a Kalign aligner instance to align biological sequences using the Kalign binary
create_a3m_output: create an A3M-formatted string from a list of biological sequences
test_kalign_align: test the Kalign align method to align multiple sequences and return A3M output
run_template_realignment: run template-to-query realignment using Kalign with old mapping and minimum fraction matching
summarize_kalign_wrapper: summarize the Kalign Python wrapper class and its sequence alignment capabilities
